headline: Sambandh Finserve’s funding flag arrived early—but did not make failure knowable
dek: A fragile wholesale-leverage reading preceded Sambandh Finserve’s recorded default. It was a filing-period vulnerability signal, not a market-price verdict, calibrated failure probability, or forecast for institutions on today’s board.

review_notes: Reframed the Sambandh finding as a filing-period vulnerability signal rather than a forecast or causal proof.
Separated filing, market-price, and model-derived evidence; retained construction-PIT, fraud-mask, freshness, and missing-data limits.

corrections.summary: Three co-operative bank failures in the India crisis record are dated at their onset, the first RBI directions restricting depositors, instead of the later licence cancellation. The India figures were regenerated, and Failure Radar tier publication is paused pending re-validation.
corrections.note: **Correction, 3 November 2026.** LiquiLens now dates three co-operative bank failures in its India crisis record at their onset, the first RBI directions restricting depositors, instead of the later licence cancellation: Madhavpura Mercantile Co-operative Bank on 13 March 2001 (previously 4 June 2012), CKP Co-operative Bank on 2 May 2014 (previously 30 April 2020) and Rupee Co-operative Bank on 22 February 2013 (previously 22 September 2022). Sources: RBI press releases of [7 June 2012](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=26606), [5 May 2014](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=31124) and [25 February 2013](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=28200). Each bank's only scored filing fell after its onset, so all three are now unscored for insufficient data rather than flagged. The India figures cited below were regenerated: the share of non-fraud failures flagged moved from 88.9% to 86.7% (13 of 15), and the median lead from 21.5 to 23 months. Failure Radar tiers are now paused pending re-validation. Board states and validation statistics below are as served on the publication date, and the text is otherwise as published.
